claims.citation: New York Herald, 18 September 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Greenock, Sept 1—The steamship Caledonia, Suply[?], ar-
rived here this afternoon after a passage of 22[?] days from
New York. One of the shafts broke when off the banks of
Newfoundland, and she had to make the balance of the pas-
sage under sail only.
